items.title: Lucky Blocks Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Would you like to be lucky? What are you waiting for? Lucky Block Teens has just hit the Marketplace! Beautiful skins that will make you lucky at any time, and best of all, they look badass!

- 10 Lucky Block teens!
- Perfect for roleplay!
- By Pixelusion & Cube Planet

items.title: Elemental Creepers
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Choose your element! Are you a Creeper of fire, water, gold or darkness? Then choose your favorite character and become the most explosive player of all servers!

- 9 elemental Creeper skins!
- Perfect for role-playing!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: Anime Magic
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Anime and magic collide in this skin pack.
Become the magician you always wanted to be with these 8 amazing anime skins!

- Includes 8 anime skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: E Girls
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Be ready for brand new trendy, e-fashioned teen girls! These skins are for true teen e-girls.

+ Teen fashion
+ E fashion
+ Ladies first
+ Girls fashion

items.title: Cave People
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Go back to the stone ages with this collection of Cave People skins!

- Six hand-crafted skins
- Inspired by the stone age and tiger print
- One skin free
- By 57Digital

items.title: Fruity PJ's
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Have a comfortable PJ-day with this set of adorable fruit-patterned pajamas!

- Six hand-crafted HD skins
- Inspired adorable kawaii fruit patterns
- 1 skin free!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Dolly
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Roleplay as one of these adorable dolly skins! Some find them cute... some find them a bit creepy! What do you think? Make your own mind up!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Emo
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
These are a great way to show off your dark style. Check out all 12 different styles and show off your favorite styles!

-12 skins included
-Emo styles
-Fun styles
-HD skins

items.title: District Agents
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Would you like to be a secret agent with special abilities? With this skin pack you can be one! Focus on the different districts of the Minecraft world and defend them from the hostile mobs of the night. Enjoy fighting for freedome with your friends and show who's the boss in Minecraft!

-Fourteen skins
-Two skins totally free
-Created by DragonClub Studios

items.title: Dragon Tales
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
What's that in the sky!? It's a dragon! Dragons are such cool and majestic creatures. Dragons breathe fire and soar through the skies! Equip a dragon skin for a perfect Medieval roleplay with your friends! 

- 11 dragon skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Hackers
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Oh no! My computer has been hacked! Join this group of hackers by playing one of them and thus ravage everywhere you go!

+ 15 skins
+ Computer knowledge and experience

items.title: Rainbow Mobs 2
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Bubbly and colorful, these mobs love bright colors and rainbows! Their love of rainbows is so strong that they themselves are covered in rainbows and colors! Show off your love of colorful things and become a rainbow mob! You'll look cool and cute all at the same time.

- 12 rainbow mob skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Among Sus 2
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
You are among suspicious strangers again! Time and time again you ask yourself how will you ever survive? There are a few among the group that can be trusted. Beware and watch your back for it may be the last thing you do! Are you a friendly astronaut or an evil one?

- 33 astronaut skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Cartoon Mobs
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Minecraft mobs have just become collectible. Gather these 20 cartoon styled characters to add to your collection.

-19 skins + 1 free skin

items.title: Zap
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description: Suit up soldier! High energy skins are here. Take on your enemies with Volt, Watt, Amp, and many more! These robust science fiction suits are yours to use for PvP, PvE, minigame, survival, and role playing worlds. Excite your friends and destroy your enemies!

items.title: Hackers and Robbers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
How to carry out the perfect crime? Team up for success. With 8 skin options to role-play as hackers and robbers, get the right mask for the job. First break into the computers and then sneak into wherever the valuables are.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cool Dogs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Cool canines rule! Hide behind some sharp shades and fancy clothes to role-play as handsome hounds and a human’s best friend. Choose from 8 perfectly groomed skins to bark and howl all you want. Wag your tail and chase the cats out of your way!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Teen Athletes
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Basketball or tennis, anyone? Get on the court and play all your favorite teen sports. Then go to a field and play some more! Choose from lots of sporty options. Stay fit when you role-play as a golfer or soccer forward. Show off your athlete skills on the open road running or biking.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Haunted River
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Start your adventure in a ruined castle on the bank of a haunted river. Look out for hostile creatures as you make your way through the abandoned city on the riverbank. Explore eerie mines in search of hidden treasures, gear up and claim these lands to be your own.

=> Perfect to role-play with friends!
=> Huge map to explore!
=> Mob fights!
=> Includes a free skin!

items.title: Cute Rainbow Dragons
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: Is that a roar I hear at the end of the rainbow? What sort of dragon guards this pot of gold? These crazy, colorful, adorable monsters would give any leprechaun a run for their money! Check out these nine high-quality dragons!

items.title: Princes and Princesses
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Hark! A doe slips through the forest, beckoning the hunting prince to give chase toward adventure! What dragon lies at the end of the tale for the noble warrior princess?
These royal adventurers are ready for whatever quest you set them on! Check out these ten high-quality skins, pick the fairest skin of all, and tally ho!

items.title: Mask Festival
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Hide your true identity behind unique and expressive masks in this skin pack filled with mysterious-yet-festive characters. From clowns and pigs to skeletons and creepers, you can don the appearance of some of your favorite characters and creatures!

- Includes 10 masked skins!
- Detailed and stylish male and female options
- By Lux Studios & Pathway Studios

items.title: Wanderlust
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Bring some realism to your world with this resource pack that will deliver an immersive experience unlike you've ever had. With next-level aesthetics, you'll want to take the time to explore every cave and corner.

- Designed to enhance the default Minecraft look while keeping its charm
- A 32x semi-realistic resource pack
- By SuperBusy Studios & Pathway Studios

items.title: Boxers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Put up your dukes and listen for the bell. Put on some gloves to start punching and jabbing in Boxers skins. Dance around the ring and try to land an uppercut. Be the ref and make sure no one hits below the belt. Support your fighter as the trainer in the corner between rounds. Bob and weave like a pro, and maybe you will be the next champion!

+ 8 knockout HD skins
